target_semantics_lesson: Focus on the precise target metric: Amazon's quarterly year-over-year revenue growth acceleration, not just growth or price.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate causal bridges by ensuring current evidence directly supports each driver, mediator, and the target link.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Test competing causal paths by re-testing preserved relationships. A path is valid only if all its edges have current, supporting evidence.
counterevidence_lesson: Weak links or contradictions in any part of a causal path invalidate it. Unsupported paths necessitate a declaration of high uncertainty.
calibration_lesson: Assess if a current factor outside the historical topology dominates the target. Search for unexplained target observations or external shocks.
